desc:
🛠️ Expand and furnish the bunker with friends 
🛒 Loot the supermarket for food, fuel, and furniture 
🌙 Stay inside the bunker at night, monsters roam outside....
⚡ Keep the generator fueled… or the power goes out
🏆 Furnish more and survive longer to unlock new rooms 
🔍 Work together to find all of the missing survivors, they are spread across the map!

⚠️If you find any bugs please report them and give us feedback
👍Please consider Liking the game and joining the group

🤔How many nights can you survive in the bunker?
